rules: Hypotheses are registered and committed before the evaluation that tests them is run.
A hypothesis is never edited after its evaluation; a changed idea gets a new id.
Reports state how many hypotheses and descriptive cells were evaluated.

hypotheses.statement: Opportunity V1 orders future movement: event rate HIGH > NORMAL > LOW for an absolute excursion >= 0.30% within +1h.
hypotheses.success_criterion: Strict ordering HIGH > NORMAL > LOW holds in the holdout segment AND in every calendar year 2020-2026.

hypotheses.statement: activity_percentile discriminates >= 0.30% excursions within +1h out of sample.
The 14-day adaptive percentile does not lose ranking information versus the raw trailing 60m range.
Adaptive states are more stable out of sample than fixed thresholds fitted on development data.
hypotheses.success_criterion: In the holdout, |share(HIGH) - 25%| + |share(LOW) - 25%| is smaller for Opportunity V1 than for the development-fitted fixed-quartile baseline.

hypotheses.statement: Opportunity V1 beats a naive recent-move baseline (|60m return|).

hypotheses.success_criterion: Strict ordering HIGH > NORMAL > LOW at +1h / 0.30% within each of the low / normal / high volatility buckets in the holdout.

hypotheses.statement: The platform reproduces the published P0.2C Opportunity event-rate tables.
hypotheses.success_criterion: Each of the 12 full-sample cells (3 states x 4 horizons) and each of the 21 yearly +1h cells is within +/-1.0 percentage point of docs/research/btc-mode/P02C_MULTIYEAR_TACTICAL_REPLAY_V0.md; every miss is explained.
